writeup: TIC 178434324 is a candidate eclipsing binary star with an orbital period of 2.3844 days. The primary eclipse causes the star to dim by 26.27%, while a secondary eclipse has been detected at 5.5 sigma significance. The binary signal shows strong detection significance with a Balmer Light-curve signal-to-noise ratio of 244.0. Pixel-level analysis using difference imaging yields a peak signal-to-noise of 81.0, though the centroid offset measures 3.1 arcseconds from the target position. Cross-referencing six variable-star catalogs found no previous record of this object. The machine-learning screening score of 0.58 indicates moderate confidence that this represents a genuine eclipsing binary system rather than a false positive or instrumental artifact.
